FeatureView.description: A feature flag for a tenant: its default, the tenant's own choice (if any) and the result.

FeedbackRow.description: One piece of feedback with its tenant, as both the tenant's admins and the operator list it.

FeedbackSubmit.description: What a user sends. byte? FeedbackSubmit.Rating is optional (1 to 5); string? FeedbackSubmit.PagePath is the page they were on.

IdentityProviderCreate.description: What creates a set of settings. The kind and key never change afterwards. New settings start disabled.

IdentityProviderRow.description:
One set of provider settings as the operator console shows it. The secret is never here: bool IdentityProviderRow.HasSecret says whether one is stored.
string IdentityProviderRow.CallbackUrl is the address to give the provider.

IdentityProviderUpdate.description: What replaces the settings. A blank ClientSecret keeps the stored one.

LinkedProvider.description: An outside account linked to a user. PrincipalUserProviderId identifies the link, for unlinking it.

LoginProvider.description: The kind of an identity provider (Google, Facebook, ...). One kind can have several sets of settings.

ModuleManifestEntry.description: The frontend module manifest for the signed-in tenant: which remotes the shell registers.

OnboardResult.description:
The outcome of onboarding. AdminInvitationUrl is the first admin's one-time link and AdminEmailSent
says whether it was also emailed; the link is null when onboarding resumed after it was already sent.

OperatorProfile.description: The signed-in operator, with the console language they chose (null: the browser's language).

PageOfAccessAuditRow.description: The one response shape for lists.

PageOfFeedbackRow.description: The one response shape for lists.

PageOfLoginRow.description: The one response shape for lists.

PageOfPrincipalSummary.description: The one response shape for lists.

PageOfTenantActivity.description: The one response shape for lists.

PageOfTenantPrincipalRow.description: The one response shape for lists.

PlanCreate.description: What creates a plan. The key never changes afterwards. The currency defaults to the platform's, the sort order to last.

PlanRow.description: One plan as the operator console shows it. int PlanRow.TenantCount counts tenants on the plan that are not deleted.

PrincipalInput.description: What creates or changes a principal. Only the fields of its PlatformPrincipalType PrincipalInput.Type are used.

PrincipalSummary.description: One row of the principal list. string? PrincipalSummary.Identifier is the email, the device's identifier or the application's owner.

Role.description: Roles, lowest to highest. A higher role includes everything a lower one can do.

SettingInfo.description: One setting of a module, for the screens that edit it.

SettingsView.description: A module's settings for a tenant: the effective values, what the tenant overrides, and what can be changed.

TenantActivity.description: One change to a tenant (plan, modules, settings, lifecycle, support access), and who made it.

TenantPrincipalRow.description: One principal's access to a tenant, as the tenant's page lists it.

TenantProfile.description: What a tenant is called and how it formats time and money. A tenant admin and an operator may change it.

TenantStatus.description: Tenant lifecycle: Provisioning → Active → Suspended (read-only) → PendingDeletion → Deleted.

UiSettings.description: What the signed-in frontend needs: branding, every flag's effective value, and the values of settings exposed to the UI.
